name: Sofia Draganova
original_name: ソフィヤ・ドラガノヴァ
source:
A Russian assassian who also does espiongage. The only daughter of a family of assassins, she came to Japan for work. She's the child of a taciturn father (taciturn) and a chatty and cheerful mother (intelligence agent). She had an older brother, but he's no longer with them so she's practically the only child. She was brought up strictly to become an excellent pawn.

She's silent, expressionless, and lacks in emotional subtleties. She thinks rationally and emphasizes efficiency. As a result, she seems to lack humanity. However, she came to like stuffed animals after coming to Japan. She was impressed by how comfortable they were to the touch. But she hides this because she doesn't want to make them a weakness.

[Translated from [url=https://saya-sp.com/hanasaya_gp_op/layer_if/layer_ifb_character/]official website[/url]]
